nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Configuration and icon-resolution helpers (file-type icon mapping, pill styling constants) used by the UploadPills components.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders uploaded file attachments as interactive pills - square image thumbnails for images and labeled pills with type icons for other files, each removable.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for uploaded files and UploadPills/UploadPill component props.

nodes.name: WorktreeSourceModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal for picking the source (branch, PR, issue, custom ref, or smart-parsed input) used to create an isolated git worktree when launching a session, combining GitHub and branch data with search, grouping, and PR-base resolution.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting SessionCreator's component set (ControlButtons, EditorArea, LaunchButton, SessionInfoLine, CliLaunchModeSwitch, ScopeInfoLine) and their prop types.

nodes.name: useWorktreeSourceData.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that preloads and caches GitHub PR/issue data and branch lists for the WorktreeSourceModal, with TTL-based freshness, LRU eviction, and in-flight de-duplication.

nodes.name: worktreeBranchSource.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions for the WorktreeSourceModal's Branch tab: converting branch cache entries to selectable options, filtering/grouping/sorting them, and mapping a chosen branch or custom ref to a WorktreeLaunchSource.

nodes.name: worktreeSmartInput.ts
nodes.summary: Pure classification and suggestion-building logic for the WorktreeSourceModal's Smart tab, turning free-text input (PR URLs, issue refs, branch names, custom refs) into an ordered list of launch suggestions.

nodes.name: worktreeSourceCache.ts
nodes.summary: Framework-agnostic cache primitives (TTL freshness classification, LRU-bounded map writes, pruning, and an in-flight request registry) backing the WorktreeSourceModal's GitHub data preload layer.

nodes.name: getFileTypeIcon
nodes.summary: Resolves the lucide icon component for a file based on its name/extension and declared type, used by non-image UploadPill rows.

nodes.name: ImagePill
nodes.summary: Internal component rendering a square image preview pill, deriving/cleaning up an object URL from a File or using a pre-optimized dataUrl path.

nodes.name: UploadPill
nodes.summary: Named-exported component rendering a non-image file as a labeled pill with a type icon and remove button.

nodes.name: UploadPills
nodes.summary: Default-exported component splitting uploaded files into image and non-image groups and rendering them as ImagePill/UploadPill rows with overflow counts.

nodes.name: smartIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a smart-suggestion kind (pr/issue/branch/name/customRef) to its display icon element.

nodes.name: githubPrToItem
nodes.summary: Converts an open PR item into a GitHubWorktreeItem row (icon, detail text, searchable text, launch source) for the GitHub tab list.

nodes.name: githubIssueToItem
nodes.summary: Converts a GitHub issue into a GitHubWorktreeItem row for the GitHub tab list.

nodes.name: SourceRefreshSuffix
nodes.summary: Internal component rendering the refresh/loading suffix (spinner or refresh button) shown at the end of a source-tab list.

nodes.name: SourceRow
nodes.summary: Internal component rendering a single selectable source-list row (icon, label, detail) shared across the Smart/Branch/GitHub tabs.

nodes.name: WorktreeSourceModal
nodes.summary: Default-exported modal component orchestrating the Smart/Branch/PR/Issue source tabs, search/filtering, GitHub+branch data loading via useWorktreeSourceData, and confirming the selected WorktreeLaunchSource including PR-base resolution.

nodes.name: fetchGithubData
nodes.summary: Fetches open PRs and issues for a repo (resolving the GitHub remote first) and assembles them into a WorktreeGithubData payload.

nodes.name: fetchBranchList
nodes.summary: Fetches the branch list for a repo via the git HTTP API.

nodes.name: useWorktreeSourceData
nodes.summary: Exported hook that preloads GitHub and branch data in parallel when the worktree source modal opens, serving cached/stale-while-revalidate results and de-duping concurrent fetches per repo key.

nodes.name: compactText
nodes.summary: Collapses whitespace and truncates a label to a max length with an ellipsis for single-line modal display.

nodes.name: toBranchOptions
nodes.summary: Converts raw Branch records into WorktreeBranchOption entries, marking remote/current/worktree flags.

nodes.name: branchCacheEntryToOptions
nodes.summary: Converts a cached branch-list entry into WorktreeBranchOption entries for the Branch tab.

nodes.name: sortBranchOptions
nodes.summary: Sorts branch options placing the current branch first, then recent/local branches, then remotes.

nodes.name: filterBranchOptions
nodes.summary: Filters branch options by a case-insensitive search query against the branch name.

nodes.name: shouldOfferCustomRef
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current search query should offer a custom-ref fallback option (no exact branch match).

nodes.name: branchToLaunchSource
nodes.summary: Maps a WorktreeBranchOption to a WorktreeLaunchSource for confirming the branch tab selection.

nodes.name: customRefToLaunchSource
nodes.summary: Maps an arbitrary custom ref string to a WorktreeLaunchSource.

nodes.name: groupBranchOptions
nodes.summary: Groups sorted branch options into Recent/Worktrees/Other-branches sections with localized fallback labels for the Branch tab.

nodes.name: formatBranchTimestamp
nodes.summary: Formats a branch's last-commit timestamp as a relative time string.

nodes.name: parsePrUrl
nodes.summary: Parses a pasted GitHub PR/issue URL or shorthand reference into a structured PR/issue identifier.

nodes.name: parseSmartInput
nodes.summary: Exported classifier that determines what kind of source (PR, issue, branch, name, custom ref) a raw smart-input string represents.

nodes.name: slugFragment
nodes.summary: Exported helper that slugifies a free-text fragment for use in generated ref/branch names.

nodes.name: nameToLaunchSource
nodes.summary: Exported helper mapping a typed name to a WorktreeLaunchSource for creating a new branch/worktree by name.

nodes.name: prSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry for a matched pull request.

nodes.name: prNumberSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry when the input is a bare PR number.

nodes.name: issueSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry for a matched GitHub issue.

nodes.name: customRefSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry offering the raw input as a custom git ref.

nodes.name: nameSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry offering the input as a new branch/worktree name.

nodes.name: foreignReferenceSuggestion
nodes.summary: Builds a smart-suggestion entry for a reference that doesn't match any known local PR/issue/branch.

nodes.name: textSuggestions
nodes.summary: Derives the ordered set of text-based suggestions (name/custom-ref/foreign-reference) from the current input and loaded data.

nodes.name: buildSmartSuggestions
nodes.summary: Exported top-level function assembling the final ordered smart-suggestion list (PR/issue/branch/text matches) for the Smart tab given the current query and loaded GitHub/branch data.

nodes.name: resolveWorktreeRepoKey
nodes.summary: Builds the per-repo cache key, preferring repoId and falling back to repoPath.

nodes.name: getWorktreeCacheFreshness
nodes.summary: Classifies a cache entry as fresh, stale, or missing relative to a TTL window.

nodes.name: isWorktreeCacheFresh
nodes.summary: Convenience predicate wrapping getWorktreeCacheFreshness to check if an entry is fresh.

nodes.name: readWorktreeCacheEntry
nodes.summary: Safe map read that tolerates a null cache key.

nodes.name: writeWorktreeCacheEntry
nodes.summary: Immutably writes a cache entry as most-recently-used, evicting the oldest entry when over the max-entries cap (LRU).

nodes.name: pruneWorktreeCache
nodes.summary: Immutably drops all cache entries older than the TTL window.

nodes.name: createInflightRegistry
nodes.summary: Creates an in-flight async-load registry that de-duplicates concurrent factory calls sharing the same key.
